painpoints.text: The survey shell here had no `upstream` remote configured (only `origin` -> `https://github.com/denkhaus/fabro`); the first fetch exited 128 with 'correct access rights' and the drift count failed on unknown revisions until I ran `git remote add upstream https://github.com/fabro-sh/fabro`. Fix idea: have the runner/sandbox bootstrap ensure the upstream mirror exists before the survey stage, or make the survey prompt's step 1 add-then-fetch unconditional.
